connector.name: Prism - Crossdeck
connector.registryDescription: Ask your app anything - revenue, errors, read-cost, growth - and get rendered charts back.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.cross-deck.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.cross-deck, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CROSSDECK_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Your Crossdeck secret key (cd_sk_…) from the dashboard → API keys. Server-side only; never a publishable key.

env.name: CROSSDECK_API_BASE
env.description: Override the API base URL (e.g. for sandbox). Optional.
